cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)
project(dasModuleFlecsGen C CXX)

# dasFlecs — flecs bindings generated by daslang's dasClangBind (see bind/bind_flecs.das).
#
# DASLANG_DIR — daslang root (include/ + lib/). Use the SAME daslang that ran the
#               generator, so the generated code matches its headers.
#
# flecs is cloned and built as a static library, pinned to the version the generated
# bindings came from. To build against a local checkout instead, pass
#   -DFLECS_DIR=C:/path/to/flecs
#
#   cmake -S . -B _build -DDASLANG_DIR=...      (from the repo root)
#   cmake --build _build --config Release

if(NOT DEFINED DASLANG_DIR)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "DASLANG_DIR must be set to the daslang root (contains include/ and lib/)")
endif()
message(STATUS "DASLANG_DIR: ${DASLANG_DIR}")

# ── flecs ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Regenerate dasFlecs/src (manage.sh gen) when changing this tag.
set(FLECS_DIR "" CACHE PATH "Local flecs checkout; empty = fetch the pinned tag")
set(FLECS_STATIC ON  CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(FLECS_SHARED OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(FLECS_TESTS  OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
if(FLECS_DIR)
    message(STATUS "flecs: local checkout ${FLECS_DIR}")
    add_subdirectory("${FLECS_DIR}" "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/_deps/flecs-build")
    set(FLECS_SOURCE_DIR "${FLECS_DIR}")
else()
    include(FetchContent)
    FetchContent_Declare(flecs
        GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/SanderMertens/flecs.git
        GIT_TAG v4.2.0
        GIT_SHALLOW TRUE
    )
    FetchContent_MakeAvailable(flecs)
    set(FLECS_SOURCE_DIR "${flecs_SOURCE_DIR}")
endif()
message(STATUS "flecs source: ${FLECS_SOURCE_DIR}")

# ── Sources ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
file(GLOB DAS_FLECS_FUNC_SRC CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/dasFlecs.func_*.cpp")
file(GLOB DAS_FLECS_GEN_HDR  CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/*.inc" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/*.h")

add_library(dasModuleFlecsGen SHARED
    src/dasFlecs.cpp
    src/dasFlecs.main.cpp
    src/dasFlecs.bridge.cpp
    ${DAS_FLECS_FUNC_SRC}
    ${DAS_FLECS_GEN_HDR}
)

target_compile_features(dasModuleFlecsGen PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
target_compile_definitions(dasModuleFlecsGen PRIVATE
    DAS_MOD_EXPORTS
    DAS_ENABLE_DLL=1
    DAS_ENABLE_EXCEPTIONS=1
    FLECS_NO_CPP
    $<$<CONFIG:Release>:DAS_NO_ASSERTIONS>
    $<$<CONFIG:MinSizeRel>:DAS_NO_ASSERTIONS>
    $<$<CONFIG:RelWithDebInfo>:DAS_NO_ASSERTIONS>
)
target_include_directories(dasModuleFlecsGen PRIVATE
    src
    "${DASLANG_DIR}/include"
)

# ── daslang dynamic libs (config subdirs first, then flat SDK layout) ──────────
foreach(_cfg Release Debug)
    if(EXISTS "${DASLANG_DIR}/lib/${_cfg}/libDaScriptDyn.lib")
        set(_DAS_LIB_DIR "${DASLANG_DIR}/lib/${_cfg}")
        break()
    endif()
endforeach()
if(NOT DEFINED _DAS_LIB_DIR)
    set(_DAS_LIB_DIR "${DASLANG_DIR}/lib")
endif()
message(STATUS "daslang libs: ${_DAS_LIB_DIR}")

if(WIN32)
    target_link_libraries(dasModuleFlecsGen PRIVATE
        "${_DAS_LIB_DIR}/libDaScriptDyn.lib"
        "${_DAS_LIB_DIR}/libDaScriptDyn_runtime.lib")
elseif(APPLE)
    target_link_libraries(dasModuleFlecsGen PRIVATE
        "${_DAS_LIB_DIR}/libDaScriptDyn.dylib"
        "${_DAS_LIB_DIR}/libDaScriptDyn_runtime.dylib")
else()
    target_link_libraries(dasModuleFlecsGen PRIVATE
        "${_DAS_LIB_DIR}/libDaScriptDyn.so"
        "${_DAS_LIB_DIR}/libDaScriptDyn_runtime.so")
endif()
# flecs_static carries flecs_STATIC and the include dir as PUBLIC usage requirements
target_link_libraries(dasModuleFlecsGen PRIVATE flecs_static)

if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(dasModuleFlecsGen PRIVATE /utf-8 /bigobj /wd4005 /MP
        $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:/Zc:__cplusplus /Zc:preprocessor>)
endif()

set_target_properties(dasModuleFlecsGen PROPERTIES SUFFIX ".shared_module" PREFIX "")

# One fixed output directory, the path .das_module loads from. The $<1:...> stops
# multi-config generators from appending their own config subdir.
set_target_properties(dasModuleFlecsGen PROPERTIES
    RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "$<1:${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/Release>"
    LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "$<1:${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/Release>"
)
if(APPLE)
    set_target_properties(dasModuleFlecsGen PROPERTIES BUILD_RPATH "@loader_path")
elseif(UNIX)
    set_target_properties(dasModuleFlecsGen PROPERTIES BUILD_RPATH "$ORIGIN")
endif()

# daslang debug runtimes look for foo_debug.shared_module
add_custom_command(TARGET dasModuleFlecsGen POST_BUILD
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different
        "$<TARGET_FILE:dasModuleFlecsGen>"
        "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:dasModuleFlecsGen>/dasModuleFlecsGen_debug.shared_module")
